title: Videwo Wakuyemo Yanga Gukina? Impamvu n'Ibisubizo
description: Videwo wakuyemo yanga gukina? Menya impamvu, kuva ku gukuramo kutarangiye kugeza kuri codec ya HEVC, hanyuma ukurikize ibisubizo byoroshye biri hano.
photoCaption: Imiterere idashyigikiwe ituma videwo yanga gukina.
photo2Caption: Gerageza irindi hitamo rya videwo cyangwa indi porogaramu.
body:
Videwo yamaze kuvamo, ariko iyo uyifunguye uhabona ubutumwa bw'ikosa, ecran y'umukara, cyangwa ishusho icikagurika? Ntucike intege vuba. Hari impamvu nke zikunze gutuma videwo wakuyemo yanga gukina, kandi inyinshi muri zo ushobora kuzikemura wenyine mu minota mike. Reka tuzirebe imwe imwe.

Kugira ngo ubyumve neza, dosiye za MP4 zikuwe kuri I Need Save zifite igihe nyacyo kandi zikina muri app ya Gallery. Bityo niba hari ikibazo, akenshi impamvu iba ari imwe muri izi zikurikira.

1. Gukuramo Ntibirarangira

Videwo zimwe zibanza gutunganywa mbere yo kuvamo, urugero amashusho n'amajwi bigahuzwa, cyangwa stream ikahindurwa MP4. Mu gihe ibi biba, buto yandikaho Birimo gutegurwa…. Niba ufunze urupapuro cyangwa interineti igacika mbere y'uko gukuramo birangira, dosiye ishobora kwangirika cyangwa ntiyuzure.

Igisubizo: ongera ukuremo videwo, utegereze kugeza gukuramo bitangiye ubwabyo, kandi urebe neza ko byarangiye ku rutonde rw'ibyakuweho muri mushakisha mbere yo gufungura dosiye.

2. Codec ya Videwo Idashyigikiwe na Telefoni Ishaje

Videwo zimwe za TikTok zikoresha codec ya HEVC (H.265). Iyi codec ituma dosiye iba nto kurushaho, ariko telefoni zishaje cyane zishobora kutayikina neza. Ibimenyetso bishobora kuba ishusho isimbuka, ecran y'umukara ifite ijwi gusa, cyangwa Gallery yanga gufungura dosiye.

Igisubizo: ongera uyikuremo maze uhitemo irindi hitamo rya videwo rihari. Ihitamo rya H.264 rikina ku bikoresho hafi ya byose. Ushobora kandi guhitamo resolution yo hasi kugira ngo yoroshye. Soma kandi itandukaniro ry'ubwiza bwa videwo 360p, 720p na 1080p kugira ngo bigufashe guhitamo.

3. Videwo Ntiragaragara muri Gallery

Kuri Android, dosiye ibikwa mu bubiko bwa Downloads, kandi app ya Gallery rimwe na rimwe ifata akanya gato kugira ngo iyigaragaze. Ushobora gutekereza ko videwo yangiritse, kandi mu by'ukuri dosiye itarasomwa gusa.

Igisubizo: fungura dosiye ako kanya uhereye muri app icunga amadosiye cyangwa ku rutonde rw'ibyakuweho muri mushakisha. Ushobora kandi gutegereza gato, hanyuma ukongera gufungura app ya Gallery.

4. Kuri iPhone, Videwo Iracyari muri App ya Files

Abakoresha iPhone na iPad bakoresha Safari bakunze kuyoberwa kuko videwo itari muri app ya Photos. Ni ukubera ko amadosiye yakuwemo ajya muri app ya Files → Downloads.

  1. Fungura app ya Files maze winjire mu bubiko bwa Downloads.
  2. Kanda kuri videwo umaze gukuramo.
  3. Kanda Share (Sangiza).
  4. Hitamo Save Video.

Nyuma yaho, videwo ishobora gukinirwa muri app ya Photos. Amabwiriza yuzuye ku hantu amadosiye abikwa ari mu nyandiko aho amadosiye wakuyemo abikwa.

5. Icyavuyemo Si Videwo

Ku rutonde rw'amahitamo, uretse videwo hari na Amajwi na Ifoto / Ifoto ntoya. Niba wahisemo amajwi utabishaka, ibyabitswe ni dosiye y'ijwi idafite amashusho. Niba wahisemo ifoto ntoya, habitswe gusa ishusho y'igifuniko.

Igisubizo: ongera ubisubiremo kandi urebe neza ko ukanda ihitamo rya videwo mu bwiza wifuza.

6. Ububiko Bwuzuye cyangwa Porogaramu Ikina Ifite Ikibazo

Ububiko bwenda kuzura bushobora gutuma dosiye itabikwa yose. Porogaramu ikina videwo cyangwa sisitemu y'imikorere ishaje na yo ishobora kugira ikibazo mu gufungura videwo zimwe.

Igisubizo: bohora umwanya muto, uvugurure sisitemu na app ya Gallery niba hari ivugurura, hanyuma wongere ukuremo videwo.

Intambwe yihuse ikunze gufasha: siba dosiye ifite ikibazo, ongera ukoporore link ukoresheje buto ya Sangiza, hanyuma wongere uyikuremo ukoresheje irindi hitamo ry'ubwiza.

Uko Wongera Kuyikuramo Neza

  1. Muri app y'urubuga nkoranyambaga, kanda Sangiza (Share) hanyuma Koporora link (Copy link).
  2. Fungura urupapuro rwo gukuramo rwa I Need Save.
  3. Omeka link cyangwa ukande Omeka, hanyuma ukande Kuramo.
  4. Hitamo ihitamo rya videwo rikwiye, kandi utegereze niba hagaragaye Birimo gutegurwa….

Wibuke ko ibikubiyemo byihariye, ibisaba kwinjira, cyangwa ibyabujijwe mu turere tumwe bidashobora gukurwamo. Bika videwo ugamije kuzikoresha ku giti cyawe gusa, kandi niba ushaka kuzongera gushyira ku rubuga, saba uruhushya uwazikoze kandi uvuge izina rye.

Ibibazo Bikunze Kubazwa

Kuki hari ijwi ariko ishusho ikaba umukara?

Akenshi ni ukubera ko telefoni idashyigikiye codec ya videwo, urugero HEVC ku gikoresho gishaje cyane. Gerageza kongera kuyikuramo ukoresheje irindi hitamo rya videwo.

Ese igihe videwo wakuyemo imara gishobora kuba atari cyo?

Dosiye za MP4 ziva kuri I Need Save zifite igihe nyacyo. Niba igihe kigaragara nk'aho atari cyo, birashoboka ko gukuramo bitarangiye, bityo ongera uyikuremo.

Videwo ikina kuri mudasobwa ariko ntikine kuri telefoni, kubera iki?

Birashoboka cyane ko ari ukubera ko ibikoresho byombi bidashyigikira codec zimwe. Gerageza guhitamo irindi hitamo rya videwo igihe ukuramo iyo kurebera kuri telefoni yawe.
